name: hubstaff
description: Start, stop and switch the Hubstaff timer by project, task or tracker key (e.g. Jira) from Claude Code.

hubstaff_token.title: Hubstaff personal access token (optional)
hubstaff_token.description: Lets the plugin look tasks up by key through the Hubstaff API when the desktop app's local cache doesn't have them. Create one at https://developer.hubstaff.com/personal_access_tokens. Leave empty to use only the desktop app.

hubstaff_cli_path.title: Hubstaff CLI path (optional)
hubstaff_cli_path.description: Full path to HubstaffCLI if the desktop app is installed somewhere non-standard.
